properties.name: DEFECT (measured 2026-10-05, main e7e304d): a check_only call to a writing tool through the door, with --no-export, prints "the committed export is now behind this write" although nothing was written. The door treats every successful call to a tool not annotated read-only as a write
properties.statement:
Met while recording a design change through the door (reflow2-mcp --no-export write create_edges with "check_only": true). The reply said applied: false and would_apply: true, and stderr said: "export NOT written (--no-export): the committed export is now behind this write." Nothing was written, so the export was not behind.

CAUSE, read in crates/reflow2-mcp/src/main.rs around line 1046: after a call whose result is not an error, `if !read_only` runs the write-through, or prints call_export::NOT_ASKED under --no-export. read_only is the tool's served annotation, so a check_only batch counts as a write. Without --no-export the same call exports, which is harmless but costs an export on a large design.

Expected: a call that wrote nothing says nothing about the export, or says it is unchanged. Workaround: ignore the line after a check_only call. Not met through MCP, where no export line is printed.
